# Generated by mods/where_to_produce/tools/generate.py. Do not edit by hand.
#
# `bag_wtp_m<n>` ranks -- effective output. `bag_wtp_b<n>` is the bonus the row
# prints. Nothing reads `_b` until a method has won a row, so it costs nothing
# per candidate.
#
# **`_m` is the output times 1000, and that is what makes it sortable.** In its own
# units a scriptorium runs from 0.3000 to 0.3129 across the whole of Europe, and
# ranking on that came back in map order: every `order_by` in the game and in
# every mod in `reference/` sorts on numbers in the thousands -- vanilla on
# `military_strength` and `country_tax_base`, Advanced Auto Build on a score
# built out of `add = 12000` -- and none on a fraction. Scaled, the same
# scriptorium runs 300.00 to 312.88 and the provinces separate. Nothing prints
# `_m`: the row's `×` is the method's own output, written out unscaled by
# `bag_wtp_store_winner`.

# The better of the two sides -- built-up and village -- in each of the three
# ages a row carries. A province with nothing but a village to offer still
# deserves its row.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_near_score = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_best >= var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
		value = var:bag_wtp_best
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_best < var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
		value = var:bag_wtp_best_rural
	}
}

# Scope: location
bag_wtp_mid_score = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_mid_best >= var:bag_wtp_mid_best_rural }
		value = var:bag_wtp_mid_best
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_mid_best < var:bag_wtp_mid_best_rural }
		value = var:bag_wtp_mid_best_rural
	}
}

# Scope: location
bag_wtp_end_score = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_end_best >= var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural }
		value = var:bag_wtp_end_best
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_end_best < var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural }
		value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural
	}
}

# **A column shrunk until it can only break a tie in the column above it.**
# Ranking by the last age puts every province that reaches the same endgame
# percentage on one number -- and where fine cloth ends in silk, that number is
# 0.00% for the whole table. What separates them then is the road there: ten
# percent until the fifth age beats nothing at all, and that is the choice the
# twentieth run asked to be able to make.
#
# A ten-thousandth of a score is at most 0.495 and the smallest step any raw
# material makes in the endgame set is 1.9, so this orders ties and can never
# reorder anything that is not tied.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_mid_tiebreak = {
	value = bag_wtp_mid_score
	multiply = 0.0001
}

# What the ranking sorts on. Two orders, one per «Считать» button: what you
# could build today, or what the ground gives at the end -- and where the end
# cannot tell two provinces apart, which it cannot whenever a ladder runs out
# (0.00% in every wool province for fine cloth), the road there decides.
#
# One operation per branch, because a script value that quietly does nothing
# logs nothing.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_score = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_rank_by_end } }
		value = bag_wtp_near_score
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_rank_by_end }
		value = bag_wtp_end_score
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_rank_by_end }
		add = bag_wtp_mid_tiebreak
	}
}

# The place the ranking gave this location, turned upside down, because
# `ordered_in_global_list` sorts **highest first** and rank 1 has to come out
# first. Ranking a list and then copying it with `every_in_global_list` is what
# lost the order once already: an unordered iterator promises nothing about the
# order it hands things back in, and the window draws its rows in the order the
# list holds them.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_rank_order = {
	value = 0
	subtract = var:bag_wtp_rank
}

# What the rights pass ranks on: every good of the bundle, each at its best
# method here, added through its price. Already scaled -- `_best` is.
#
# «На конец» adds the road there, shrunk until it can only break a tie -- and
# the tie it breaks is the whole table at once, because where no surviving
# recipe can be fed every province is worth exactly zero. A hundred-thousandth
# of a bundle's total is at most 0.065 and the smallest step a bundle's own
# total takes is about 0.6.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_r_mid_tiebreak = {
	value = var:bag_wtp_r_mid_total
	multiply = 0.00001
}

# Scope: location
bag_wtp_r_score = {
	value = var:bag_wtp_r_total
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_rank_by_end }
		add = bag_wtp_r_mid_tiebreak
	}
}


# clay. **Divided by how much of it this province already has**, which is the
# whole of what keeps a province's locations from coming out identical: every
# location of a province is worth exactly the same to a good -- the bonus is a
# `province_definition`'s property -- so undivided, a good takes all of its best
# province before it looks at its second. And nothing is ever twice as good: the
# bonus is a ten per cent band (`docs/investigations/plan_formula.md`), so
# halving is decisive. `_pp<n>` is that count, kept on every location of the
# province so the ordering can read it without leaving the location's scope.
# The divisor is written inline rather than as a value of its own: a `divide`
# with a `value`/`min` block inside is the shape vanilla uses (`byz_values.txt`),
# and `divide = <a named script value>` bare has no precedent in the game.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_ord1 = {
	value = var:bag_wtp_p1
	divide = {
		value = 1
		add = var:bag_wtp_pp1
		min = 1
	}
}
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_ordr1 = {
	value = var:bag_wtp_pr1
	divide = {
		value = 1
		add = var:bag_wtp_pp1
		min = 1
	}
}
# The undecayed pair, which is what the good is normalized by and what counts
# its candidates: the divisor is about where the next building goes, never about
# whether this ground can hold the good at all.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_ordmax1 = {
	value = var:bag_wtp_p1
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_pr1 > var:bag_wtp_p1 }
		value = var:bag_wtp_pr1
	}
}

	value = var:bag_wtp_p14
	divide = {
		value = 1
		add = var:bag_wtp_pp14
		min = 1
	}
}
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_ordr14 = {
	value = var:bag_wtp_pr14
	divide = {
		value = 1
		add = var:bag_wtp_pp14
		min = 1
	}
}
# The undecayed pair, which is what the good is normalized by and what counts
# its candidates: the divisor is about where the next building goes, never about
# whether this ground can hold the good at all.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_ordmax14 = {
	value = var:bag_wtp_p14
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_pr14 > var:bag_wtp_p14 }
		value = var:bag_wtp_pr14
	}
}

# salt. **Divided by how much of it this province already has**, which is the
# whole of what keeps a province's locations from coming out identical: every
# location of a province is worth exactly the same to a good -- the bonus is a
# `province_definition`'s property -- so undivided, a good takes all of its best
# province before it looks at its second. And nothing is ever twice as good: the
# bonus is a ten per cent band (`docs/investigations/plan_formula.md`), so
# halving is decisive. `_pp<n>` is that count, kept on every location of the
# province so the ordering can read it without leaving the location's scope.
# The divisor is written inline rather than as a value of its own: a `divide`
# with a `value`/`min` block inside is the shape vanilla uses (`byz_values.txt`),
# and `divide = <a named script value>` bare has no precedent in the game.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_ord15 = {
	value = var:bag_wtp_p15
	divide = {
		value = 1
		add = var:bag_wtp_pp15
		min = 1
	}
}
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_ordr15 = {
	value = var:bag_wtp_pr15
	divide = {
		value = 1
		add = var:bag_wtp_pp15
		min = 1
	}
}
# The undecayed pair, which is what the good is normalized by and what counts
# its candidates: the divisor is about where the next building goes, never about
# whether this ground can hold the good at all.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_ordmax15 = {
	value = var:bag_wtp_p15
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_pr15 > var:bag_wtp_p15 }
		value = var:bag_wtp_pr15
	}
}

# fine_cloth. **Divided by how much of it this province already has**, which is the
# whole of what keeps a province's locations from coming out identical: every
# location of a province is worth exactly the same to a good -- the bonus is a
# `province_definition`'s property -- so undivided, a good takes all of its best
# province before it looks at its second. And nothing is ever twice as good: the
# bonus is a ten per cent band (`docs/investigations/plan_formula.md`), so
# halving is decisive. `_pp<n>` is that count, kept on every location of the
# province so the ordering can read it without leaving the location's scope.
# The divisor is written inline rather than as a value of its own: a `divide`
# with a `value`/`min` block inside is the shape vanilla uses (`byz_values.txt`),
# and `divide = <a named script value>` bare has no precedent in the game.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_ord30 = {
	value = var:bag_wtp_p30
	divide = {
		value = 1
		add = var:bag_wtp_pp30
		min = 1
	}
}
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_ordr30 = {
	value = var:bag_wtp_pr30
	divide = {
		value = 1
		add = var:bag_wtp_pp30
		min = 1
	}
}
# The undecayed pair, which is what the good is normalized by and what counts
# its candidates: the divisor is about where the next building goes, never about
# whether this ground can hold the good at all.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_ordmax30 = {
	value = var:bag_wtp_p30
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_pr30 > var:bag_wtp_p30 }
		value = var:bag_wtp_pr30
	}
}

# `province_definition`'s property -- so undivided, a good takes all of its best
# province before it looks at its second. And nothing is ever twice as good: the
# bonus is a ten per cent band (`docs/investigations/plan_formula.md`), so
# halving is decisive. `_pp<n>` is that count, kept on every location of the
# province so the ordering can read it without leaving the location's scope.
# The divisor is written inline rather than as a value of its own: a `divide`
# with a `value`/`min` block inside is the shape vanilla uses (`byz_values.txt`),
# and `divide = <a named script value>` bare has no precedent in the game.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_ord45 = {
	value = var:bag_wtp_p45
	divide = {
		value = 1
		add = var:bag_wtp_pp45
		min = 1
	}
}
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_ordr45 = {
	value = var:bag_wtp_pr45
	divide = {
		value = 1
		add = var:bag_wtp_pp45
		min = 1
	}
}
# The undecayed pair, which is what the good is normalized by and what counts
# its candidates: the divisor is about where the next building goes, never about
# whether this ground can hold the good at all.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_ordmax45 = {
	value = var:bag_wtp_p45
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_pr45 > var:bag_wtp_p45 }
		value = var:bag_wtp_pr45
	}
}

# tools. **Divided by how much of it this province already has**, which is the
# whole of what keeps a province's locations from coming out identical: every
# location of a province is worth exactly the same to a good -- the bonus is a
# `province_definition`'s property -- so undivided, a good takes all of its best
# province before it looks at its second. And nothing is ever twice as good: the
# bonus is a ten per cent band (`docs/investigations/plan_formula.md`), so
# halving is decisive. `_pp<n>` is that count, kept on every location of the
# province so the ordering can read it without leaving the location's scope.
# The divisor is written inline rather than as a value of its own: a `divide`
# with a `value`/`min` block inside is the shape vanilla uses (`byz_values.txt`),
# and `divide = <a named script value>` bare has no precedent in the game.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_ord46 = {
	value = var:bag_wtp_p46
	divide = {
		value = 1
		add = var:bag_wtp_pp46
		min = 1
	}
}
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_ordr46 = {
	value = var:bag_wtp_pr46
	divide = {
		value = 1
		add = var:bag_wtp_pp46
		min = 1
	}
}
# The undecayed pair, which is what the good is normalized by and what counts
# its candidates: the divisor is about where the next building goes, never about
# whether this ground can hold the good at all.
# Scope: location

	value = var:bag_wtp_p46
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_pr46 > var:bag_wtp_p46 }
		value = var:bag_wtp_pr46
	}
}

# constantinopolitan_silk_monopoly_rights: cloth, fine_cloth, silk.
#
# **Divided by how often this right has already been granted**, the same shape
# as a good's province divisor and for the same reason. Every town of a province
# scores identically, so undivided they all take the one right -- five towns of
# Münsterland took the masonry and glass charter four times over on the
# thirty-sixth run, and every one of them then held the same two buildings. A
# right that is genuinely better still wins; a tie now spreads.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_rq1 = {
	value = 0
	add = var:bag_wtp_p29
	add = var:bag_wtp_p30
	add = var:bag_wtp_p18
	divide = {
		value = 1
		add = global_var:bag_wtp_rgiven1
		min = 1
	}
}

# The divisor the plan normalizes by: the best this ground is worth to whatever
# good is being harvested. A script value and not `divide = global_var:`, because
# `divide` takes a script value for certain and the other form is only inferred.
bag_wtp_plan_top_value = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_top }

# The same, for the quota: how many goods this ground can make at all. Divided by
# only under a `limit` that it is above zero, so the guard is the caller's.
bag_wtp_plan_scored_value = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_scored }

# How the plan's provinces are ordered: by how much of it landed in each, read
# off the one location that stands in for the province. Under the province model
# every province fills to its capacity, so this is size and contention together
# -- the «магнит» the feature is named for.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_plan_prov_order = { value = var:bag_wtp_plan_prov_load }

# And how a location's row is ordered: by its province's place, so a province's
# locations stay together, with its towns ahead of its villages. Negated because
# `ordered_in_global_list` sorts highest first and place 1 has to come out first.
#
# **Small numbers on purpose.** Packing the province's load and its place into
# one figure would run to five digits, and where the engine's fixed point ends is
# not knowable from here -- `RIGHT_SCALE` is in the generator for the same
# reason.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_plan_order = {
	value = 0
	subtract = var:bag_wtp_plan_prank
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
		add = 0.5
	}
}

# And the copy into the window's datamodel keeps that order the way the
# ranking's does: highest first, so the rank is negated.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_plan_rank_order = {
	value = 0
	subtract = var:bag_wtp_plan_rank
}

bag_wtp_show_regions = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_zone_count }
bag_wtp_show_candidates = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_candidate_count }
bag_wtp_show_found = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_found }
bag_wtp_show_picked = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_picked_count }
bag_wtp_show_browse = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_browse_count }
bag_wtp_show_live = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_live_runs }

# What the plan pass counted, each of them printed on the button that ran it.
# The first zero among them is the diagnosis, which is the only debugging a
# player can be asked for: an effect that merely does nothing logs nothing.
bag_wtp_show_plan_scored = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_scored }
bag_wtp_show_plan_placed = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_placed }
bag_wtp_show_plan_found = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_found }
bag_wtp_show_plan_shown = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_shown }
bag_wtp_show_plan_rooms = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_rooms }
bag_wtp_show_plan_cap_rural = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_rural }
bag_wtp_show_plan_cap_urban = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban }
bag_wtp_show_plan_max = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max }
# The fair share the quota came out at, on the header line: with the room count
# and the goods count beside it, it is the whole of `plan_quota` readable at a
# glance, and a quota of 1 says the ground is the binding constraint.
bag_wtp_show_plan_quota = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_quota }
bag_wtp_show_plan_sweeps = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_sweeps }
bag_wtp_show_plan_towns = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_towns }
bag_wtp_show_plan_provn = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_provn }
bag_wtp_show_plan_rightn = { value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_rightn }
